claims: Steve Sarkisian is the head football coach for the University of Texas Longhorns.
Steve Sarkisian has held the position of head football coach for the University of Texas Longhorns since 2021.
Under Steve Sarkisian's leadership, the University of Texas Longhorns football team has achieved CFP appearances.
Under Steve Sarkisian's leadership, the University of Texas Longhorns football team has transitioned into the SEC.
Steve Sarkisian is often called "Coach Sark".
Steve Sarkisian has a multi-year contract with Texas that included a guaranteed $34.2 million over six years.
As of early 2026, reports indicate Will Muschamp was hired to lead the defense.
The University of Texas Longhorns football team moved on from Pete Kwiatkowski.
The University of Texas Longhorns coaching staff includes Jeff Banks (Special Teams/TE).
The University of Texas Longhorns coaching staff includes Kenny Baker (Defensive Line).
Steve Sarkisian has led Texas to multiple bowl games.
Steve Sarkisian was named to the Bear Bryant Coach of the Year Award watch list in 2024.
